verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Gazebo supports sensor plugins generically ('Develop custom plugins for robot, sensor, and environment control') and has ROS integration (ros_gz) for bridging messages, but no specific evidence names ready-made camera/lidar/IMU/GPS sensor plugins or standard message type mappings (e.g., sensor_msgs). missing for 10: explicit documentation of built-in camera/lidar/IMU/GPS sensor plugins, standard message type specifications (ROS or Gazebo msgs), and independent confirmation of these drivers working out-of-the-box.
